run.question: Which service has the most error events in the events collection? What is the most common error code for that service and how many times does it appear?

report.summary: In the only collection in the configured database (opsdb), `events`, the service with the most error-level events is payment-processor with 47 error documents. Its most common error code is TXN-4821, which appears 23 times; the other payment-processor codes are TXN-5190 (14) and TXN-3007 (10). The whole collection is 200 documents: 133 level=error (every one carrying an error_code) and 67 level=info (none carrying an error_code), and the per-service error counts sum to exactly 133, so no service outside the returned groups holds an error event. This is a data-inventory answer, not a fault triage: no root cause is asserted, and the documents' own timestamps (2025-12-01T00:00:00 to 2025-12-01T03:19:00) fall entirely outside the authorized window (2026-11-20T08:59:35Z to 2026-11-21T08:59:35Z), so these counts describe the collection as it stands at query time rather than activity inside the incident window.

claims.text: The configured MongoDB database opsdb contains exactly one collection, `events`, and the `events` collection schema has fields _id, error_code, level, message, service and timestamp with an estimated document count of 200.

Grouping `events` by level and whether error_code is present returns only two groups: level=error with an error_code present, 133 documents, and level=info with no error_code, 67 documents (133 + 67 = 200).

Grouping `events` by service and level gives error-level counts of payment-processor 47, inventory-sync 31, user-auth 25, notification-hub 18 and search-indexer 12 (sum 133), plus info-level counts of inventory-sync 14, payment-processor 14, notification-hub 13, user-auth 13 and search-indexer 13 (sum 67); payment-processor therefore has the highest number of error events.

For service payment-processor, grouping by level and error_code returns error/TXN-4821 23 documents, error/TXN-5190 14 documents, error/TXN-3007 10 documents (sum 47) and info with no error_code 14 documents, so TXN-4821 is the most frequent error code for that service.

Sampled payment-processor error documents written with error_code TXN-4821 carry the message 'Transaction timeout waiting for bank response', for example at timestamp 2025-12-01T00:00:00 and 2025-12-01T00:01:00.
The timestamps of the 200 `events` documents range from 2025-12-01T00:00:00 to 2025-12-01T03:19:00, which lies entirely before the authorized window start of 2026-11-20T08:59:35Z.

The repetition of TXN-4821 with the fixed message 'Transaction timeout waiting for bank response' at one-minute intervals suggests a payment-processor transaction timeout condition sustained across the documented interval, but the error text alone does not identify the failing dependency.

gaps: The `events` documents' own timestamps (2025-12-01T00:00:00 to 2025-12-01T03:19:00) are outside the authorized window, so these counts are the collection's state at query time and cannot show which errors occurred during 2026-11-20T08:59:35Z–2026-11-21T08:59:35Z; no per-window breakdown of `events` at incident time is available.

The service values in `events` (payment-processor, inventory-sync, user-auth, notification-hub, search-indexer) do not match any service name offered for tracing (accounting, ad, cart, checkout, currency, email, fraud-detection, frontend, frontend-proxy, image-provider, kafka, load-generator, payment, product-catalog, quote, recommendation, shipping), so how these event services map to the traced workloads is unknown.
No documents beyond a 3-row sample of payment-processor TXN-4821 errors were read, so full message text and any other fields per document were not inspected.
Change history is not an integrated source in this Run, so when or by what the payment-processor error condition was introduced cannot be checked.
